faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know before getting started.

general.q1: Can I use Waelly on my phone?
general.a1: Yes. Waelly works on phone and computer, with the same account and the same data, updated in real time.
general.q2: Do I need an internet connection?
general.a2: A connection is needed to record and sync your transactions. Pages already open remain viewable.
general.a3: FCFA by default. You can choose another currency in settings, along with the language and low-stock threshold.
general.a4: Your data is encrypted in transit and backed up. Only you and the collaborators you invite have access.

factures.a1: Yes: logo, legal and bank details, visual theme, discounts, taxes and shipping fees.
factures.q2: How do I send an invoice to a client?
factures.a2: Download the PDF or share it directly, then track its status: draft, sent, paid.
factures.q3: Does a paid invoice create a sale?
factures.a3: Yes. When an invoice is marked paid, the sale and the stock are updated automatically.
factures.q4: Can I invoice services with no stock?
factures.a4: Yes, add free-form lines alongside your stock items.

compte.q1: How do I create my account?
compte.a1: By email with a verification code, or in one click with Google or Facebook.
compte.q2: Can my team use the same account?
compte.a2: Add your collaborators with their role, their share and their contact details.
compte.q3: Can I change plans at any time?
compte.a3: Yes, you can switch between plans whenever you like.
compte.q4: How do I delete my account?
compte.a4: From Settings > Security. Deletion permanently erases your data.
